text.guided: This picture was crushed flat: its determinant is 0, so many different points were squeezed onto the same spot. No matrix can pull them apart again. Before you build an inverse, check the determinant ad − bc: if it is 0, press CAN'T REPAIR.
text.fast: det = 0 means no inverse. Check ad − bc first.

scene.caption: A picture with its two arrows
Both arrows on the same line: no arrow can tell the points apart
